params.name: minDate
params.description: Only get appointments this date and after

params.name: maxDate
params.description: Only get appointments this date and before

params.name: calendarID
params.description: Show only appointments on calendar with specified ID

params.name: appointmentTypeID
params.description: Show only appointments of this type

params.name: canceled
params.description: Get canceled appointments (include noShow field in response)

params.name: showall
params.description: Retrieve both canceled and scheduled appointments

params.name: firstName
params.description: Filter appointments for client first name

params.name: lastName
params.description: Filter appointments for client last name

params.name: email
params.description: Filter appointments for client e-mail address

params.name: phone
params.description: Filter appointments for client phone number. If using a country code, ensure that the '+' is URL encoded to %2b

params.name: field:id
params.description: Filter appointments matching a particular custom intake form field e.g. ?field:1234=Hello

params.name: excludeForms
params.description: Don't include intake forms in the response object (speeds up the response)

items.docs: Get a list of appointments currently scheduled for the authenticated user.

params.name: admin
params.description: Book as admin — disables availability and attribute validations, allows setting notes. Requires a valid calendarID in the request body.

params.name: noEmail
params.description: Don't send confirmation e-mails or SMS

items.docs: Create an appointment. By default, availability and forms are validated as if the appointment is being booked by a client. Use admin=true to disable availability and attribute validations and to allow setting notes.

params.name: admin
params.description: Update as admin — allows setting notes and certificate, disables attribute validations.

items.docs: Update appointment details from a whitelist of updatable attributes. Attributes not included in the request body or not on the whitelist will be ignored. Appointments can be rescheduled and canceled with separate APIs.
Retrieve a list of payment transactions for a particular appointment.
